charts.styling: Use soft organic wave charts (spline/monotone) rather than jagged lines. Remove heavy grid lines, use soft dashed #E2E8F0. Area charts should use gradient fills from #0EA5E9 to transparent.

instructions_to_main_agent: REPLACE all hardcoded dark olive green (#2D4A3E), muddy terracotta (#D96C4E) and off-white (#FAFAF9) with the new Sky Blue (#0EA5E9), Mint Green (#10B981) and Slate 50 (#F8FAFC) palette defined here.
Implement Crystal Glassmorphism on the main site header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70).
Use Outfit for all Headings (with tracking-tighter) and Figtree for Body text. Ensure you import them from Google Fonts in index.css.
Add 'data-testid' to every button, link, and form input.
For the daily tracker and charts, use organic wave (monotone) lines and soft gradient fills underneath the lines, avoiding rigid 90-degree lines.
Replace square, harsh borders with rounded-2xl for all dashboard cards.
Ensure all text meets minimum contrast requirements against the white and slate backgrounds. Do not use generic 1px borders without a soft shadow.
